Package org.osgi.impl.service.zigbee.basedriver

Class ZCLFrameImpl

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.impl.service.zigbee.basedriver.ZigBeeSerializer
org.osgi.impl.service.zigbee.basedriver.ZCLFrameImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ZCLFrame
Direct Known Subclasses:
ZCLFrameRaw
public class ZCLFrameImpl extends ZigBeeSerializer implements ZCLFrame
This is a mock implementation of the ZCLFrame interface. This implementation is far from a real one, and it is provided to allow to test the test cases of the ZigBee Device Service. It cannot be complete for ZigBee spec licensing problems.
